changes: GAP 5 — fully-auto update: update downloads once, then applies itself the next time you open the app — no Restart click
Render speed — adaptive Fast Render: GPU canvas when a GPU encoder is present, CPU canvas otherwise, plus an FPS gate that falls back to normal render if Fast Render is slower
Team Settings — new Latest Version section at the bottom shows your version vs the latest version, with a Download button
Groq 429 resilience — transcribe now rotates keys visibly, waits the exact time Groq asks, falls back to another model, and resumes from the failed chunk instead of starting over
Transitions — picking a transition now applies it to all scenes at once (per-scene override still available)
Captions — the style you pick is now used exactly; no forced black strip behind captions
Team gaps — remove approved members, live ACTIVE/OFFLINE status, changelog before auto-update, red Update box in Team Settings
Usage — Admin now shows each PC's username (@username) next to it
Timecode merge — short windows now join into 5–10 sec windows, sentences never split, duplicate timecodes gone (301/311 fix)
Transcribe guard — suspect words are checked, retried and warned, never silently wrong
Render speed — faster Fast Render with GPU encoder probe and software fallback
Project switch fix — old project images no longer leak into a new project; second project renders
38 free Edge TTS voices — Documentary, Motivation, Horror, Education, Reels, British, Spanish, Urdu
Studio Pro final flow — drop audio + images, editor opens automatically, Generate Captions from Audio
